completion: One coherent primary-source documentation or grouped clarification packet, existing-policy explanation or duplicate/no-value result.
decision_rules: Distinguish bytes retained by parser, fields reconstructed by kernel, subsequent comparisons and independent-validator behavior.
Use historical checker records only under their bound identities; do not transfer outcomes to current source.
Source implementation, agreement and package policy do not create universal semantic authority; preserve unresolved requirements.
No new catalog or authority decisions; no new export, checker, build, proof, mutation or external research write.
Prepare at most one grouped documentation question when a concrete unsettled export/import contract remains; suppress duplicate submissions and keep any draft local.
source_protocol: Reuse exact retained source where applicable. Record each current source/duplicate request including failures. Bind exact source snapshots/archives and fixed field/evidence set before substantive comparison; current implementation claims require exact revision.
successor_rule: At closure compare all READY opportunities and project-wide categories; select one READY unstarted successor, then main delivery and stop.
